lines.text: Over 81 million people traveling for Thanksgiving, and I'll still beat traffic.
lines.say: Over eighty-one million people traveling for Thanksgiving, and I'll still beat traffic.

lines.text: AAA says about 81.5 million, Tuesday to Monday. Nearly nine in ten drive.
lines.say: Triple A says about eighty-one and a half million, Tuesday to Monday. Nearly nine in ten drive.

lines.text: Today's one of the busiest road days. And storms are in the forecast.
Relax. I leave at noon, I'm there in three hours. Tops.
You said that last year. It took seven.
Last year was bad luck. This year is different.
In 1994, Roger Buehler asked students when they'd finish their thesis. They guessed about 34 days. It took about 56.
lines.say: In nineteen ninety-four, Roger Buehler asked students when they'd finish their thesis. They guessed about thirty-four days. It took about fifty-six.

lines.text: We picture the best case, and forget every trip that went wrong.
The fix? Plan with your last real trip time, not your hopes.
So I leave at five a.m.?
Leave whenever. Just believe the old number.
Be honest. How late will you be? Tell us in the comments.
